prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: authored 2D game sprite sheet. Reference is a cute cream-white garden rabbit, two long fluffy pink-inner ears, two large brown eyes in white sockets, pink nose and cheeks, forehead tuft, fluffy round tail SCREENLEFT, two front paws and two hind feet. Keep exactly same identity, fur markings, proportions and three-quarter RIGHT camera in every frame; never mirror. Four complete SMALL figures in strict 2x2 grid centers25/75percent, including ears max30percent total canvas width/height. Wide empty transparent gutters x43-57/y43-57 and generous outer margins. True transparent alpha; no background, floor, shadows, haze, halo, text, panels, particles, loose fur, duplicate limbs or props. Actual joint/ear/face pose changes, not scaled copies. Four idle poses row-major:1 relaxed open eyes;2 gentle ear-tip bend/open eyes;3 both eyelids half closed;4 both eyes fully closed with opaque cream fur lids covering all iris and whites, soft curved lash line. Paws/feet stay attached and eyes stay in their sockets.
